CustomField.formula: IF( OR( CONTAINS(UPPER($UserRole.Name), 'CEO'), CONTAINS(UPPER($UserRole.Name), 'SALES OPERATIONS') ), $UserRole.Name, IF( CONTAINS(UPPER($UserRole.Name), 'SME'), 'SME', IF( CONTAINS(UPPER($UserRole.Name), 'FIELD SALES'), 'Field Sales', IF( CONTAINS(UPPER($UserRole.Name), 'LPF'), 'LPF', '' ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Role Type
